start.description: Minimum (or maximum) value in the range equals this value.

stop.description: Maximum (or minimum) value in the range is equal to or less than (or greater than) this value.

stepSize.description: Constant step size between contiguous values.

title:
This type defines a real parameter space, where the valid values for a hyperparameter range from a start
value (inclusive), a stop value (inclusive) and an optional step size with a default value of +1.

Usage Examples:
Setting fields as {start: 1.1, stop: 11.1, stepSize: 2.5} would give real values in the set {1.1, 3.6, 6.1, 8.6, 11.1}.
Setting fields as {start: 11.1, stop: 1.1, stepSize: -2.5} would give real values in the set {11.1, 8.6, 6.1, 3.6, 1.1}.
Setting fields as {start: 1.1, stop: 11.1, stepSize: -2.5} would give no values (invalid range).

An example of defining a {@link Hp.ParamSpace.RealRange}:
```py
real_space = c3.Hp.ParamSpace.RealRange.fromRange(start=5.0, stop=20.0, stepSize=3)
```
name: Hp.ParamSpace.RealRange
